---
title: "Gallery"
---

Each chart below is drawn from the code under it, with real data defined at the top of [`examples/catalog.php`](https://github.com/phpstats/phiz/blob/main/examples/catalog.php):

| Variable | Data |
| --- | --- |
| `$mpg`, `$mtcars`, `$economics`, `$faithful` | the bundled datasets: ggplot2's `mpg` and `economics`, and R's `mtcars` and `faithful`, from `Datasets` |
| `$gapminder` | [gapminder](https://github.com/phpstats/datasets#gapminder): life expectancy, population, and GDP per capita of 142 countries, 1952 to 2007 |
| `$fit`, `$reduced` | linear models of `mtcars` fuel economy, fitted in PHP |
| `$schools` | posterior draws of the [eight schools](https://github.com/phpstats/datasets#schools) model, sampled with CmdStanPHP |
| `$hwyMean`, `$hwySd` | the mean and standard deviation of highway mpg in `mpg` |
